propositions: No workflow file in .github/workflows/ should trigger on a push to the tickets branch; the tickets branch is an orphan with no .github/ directory, making push-triggered runs structurally impossible, but branch filters must be explicit for maintainability.

Four workflows (test.yml, optionality.yml, prompt-eval.yml, verify-identity.yml) use the branches-ignore idiom and must have 'tickets' appended to their lists alongside existing exclusions of 'feature/**' and 'main'.

An enumerating test must be added to tests/unit/test_ci_tickets_push_policy.py that reads .github/workflows/ from disk and asserts no discovered workflow push-matches 'tickets', preventing silent regression if a workflow is added with a bare 'push:' trigger.

Scheduled workflow cron expressions (reconcile-bridge */20 * * * *, verify-identity 53 */6 * * *, test 41 */6 * * *, optionality 47 */6 * * *, prompt-eval weekly 0 7 * * 1) must remain byte-identical; no schedule: block is modified.

Adopter documentation must be added to docs/concurrency.md (canonical warning), docs/user-guide.md (pointer), and docs/config.md (sync.remote annotation) cautioning that ticket-store auto-pushes on every write can trigger CI if not filtered, recommending schedules instead.
gerrit-verify.yaml must remain workflow_dispatch-only per operator instruction; existing test test_gerrit_verify_stays_a_dispatch_only_patchset_gate must continue passing.
